g.text: Layer 1 · throwaway Vultr VM: one per scan, deleted after, reaper at 20 min
Layer 2 · network jail: iptables sends every DNS / TCP packet to fakenet; forwarding dropped
Layer 3 · gVisor (runsc): a user-space kernel; the repo sees 4.19.0-gvisor
Layer 4 · container: user dev, all caps dropped, 2 GB / 1.5 CPU / 512 pids
Red-team repo, run as a take-home
contained · SSH to the host → no banner
contained · become root / mount disk → failed
sandbox dies, host fine, verdict SUSPICIOUS
